original: WPRPLACE is a village in the arrondissement of Neufchâteau in the Belgian province of Luxembourg. WPRPLACE became an independent municipality in 1858 when it was separated from Vivy and remained until 1 January 1977. The place is located on the Semois. To the south of the village centre lies the village of Frahan, on a meander in this river.
